description: This file contains utility template functions for generating command-line flags, processing collections, and merging data structures, specifically related to 'cvd' environment configuration in the Android Open Source Project. It also includes template functions leveraging fmt and protobuf for flag generation, as well as JSON utilities.

methods.name: std::string GenerateFlag(const std::string & name,const T & value)
methods.description: Generates a command-line flag string for a given name and value.

methods.name: std::string GenerateVecFlag(const std::string & name,const T & collection)
methods.description: Generates a command-line flag for a collection of values.

methods.name: std::string GenerateInstanceFlag(const std::string & name,const cvd::config::EnvironmentSpecification & config,T callback)
methods.description: Creates a flag from environment instances, applying a callback to each instance.

methods.name: Result<std::string> ResultInstanceFlag(const std::string & name,const cvd::config::EnvironmentSpecification & config,T callback)
methods.description: Creates a flag from environment instances with error handling using Result.

methods.name: MergeTwoJsonObjs
methods.description: Merges the contents of one JSON object into another.

ctags.name: GenerateFlag
ctags.pattern: /^std::string GenerateFlag(const std::string& name, const T& value) {$/

ctags.name: GenerateVecFlag
ctags.pattern: /^std::string GenerateVecFlag(const std::string& name, const T& collection) {$/
